name: Jumbo marker
description: A fat permanent marker with a chisel tip. Its ink stays on wood, metal and concrete.
notes: 14 cm long and 22 mm across, chisel tip under the clipped cap at +x. writing is a new quality name for marking walls, maps and notes. box/volume x1.9 is the clip and cap ring standing off a round barrel.

name: Pocket watch
description: A gold pocket watch with a winding crown and a ring for a chain. It still keeps time when wound.
notes: 50 mm case lying face up, crown and bow at 12 o'clock on +z. The crystal is left out so the dial and hands read in the tile; enamel-white dial, metal-gold case. Telling the time and taking it apart for gears and gold need fields the content pass adds.

name: Porcelain urn
description: A glazed porcelain urn with a gold band and a fitted lid, made to hold ashes. It holds water and stands heat.
notes: 30 cm tall and 20 cm across the belly, with a gold band and knob. cooking is at 1 because a thin porcelain pot is a poor one. The box is round a round body.

name: Riding crop
description: A thin, springy fibreglass rod with a leather grip and a flat leather tab at the tip.
notes: 60 cm long, tapering from 12 to 5 mm, with a leather grip and knob and a 4 by 3 cm popper at +x. The model follows the shape of a thin rod. A melee block (a weak lash) is for the content pass.

name: Foam sleeping mat
description: A closed-cell foam mat rolled and strapped for carrying. Laid out, it keeps the cold of the ground off a sleeper.
notes: Rolled, 55 cm long and 16 cm across with two webbing straps and the spiral of the layers drawn on each end. Unrolling it into a placed bed needs a placeable field the content pass adds. A camp chair variant is a different object (a folding chair) that cannot share a rolled mat's model; it needs its own row and is left out here.

name: Combination lockbox
description: A heavy steel box with a number dial and a turn handle on the front. Whatever is inside stays there without the combination.
notes: 24 by 12 by 14 cm with the dial and handle on +z and the lid hinged at the back. hammering 1: the box is heavy enough to knock with. Holding contents behind a combination and forcing it open, ruining what is inside, need fields the content pass adds.

name: Toy bucket and spade
description: A child's plastic bucket with a toy spade and rake standing in it.
notes: Bucket 16 cm across and 13 cm tall with a handle, spade and rake heads above the rim. The model shows the tools standing in the bucket. digging is a new quality name, at 1 because a toy spade barely digs. Taking the spade and rake out as their own items needs content the pass adds.

name: Access code printout
description: A folded printout with a long string of digits on it, an access code for a sealed facility's lift.
notes: A letter sheet folded in three, 21.6 by 9.3 cm, with a header bar, ten digit blocks and lines of text drawn as raised print. At the 2 mm grain a folded sheet reads 4 mm thick. Which door it opens is a key field the content pass adds, tied to whatever sealed site it belongs to.

name: Space heater
description: A small electric heater with a grille over its heating bars. Plugged in, it warms a room by several degrees.
notes: 20 cm wide, 25 cm tall and 11 cm deep with the grille on +z, two knobs and a carry bar on top. Heating the air around it needs a heat source field the content pass adds; the running state is its own draft below.

name: Space heater (on)
description: A small electric heater, switched on, its bars glowing orange behind the grille.
notes: Shares the space heater's model; the glowing bars and lamp tell the running state apart.

name: Can of spray paint
description: An aerosol can of red paint with a matching cap. Enough to mark walls, doors and floors.
notes: 21 cm tall to the cap and 66 mm across, a label band round a red body. painting is a new quality name for marking with paint. The box is round a round can; the model follows the shape.

name: Butane can
description: A pressurised can of butane gas for refilling lighters and small stoves.
notes: Shares the spray can's model in blue with a white cap. Refilling lighters and torches from it needs a fuel field the content pass adds.

name: Wooden stepladder
description: A heavy wooden stepladder with five treads and steel spreader bars. Set down, it reaches high shelves, ceilings and low roofs.
notes: Standing open, 1.46 m to the top cap, 50 cm wide and 86 cm deep at the feet, treads facing +z. The box counts the open A-frame. climbing is a new quality name for reaching a higher level; the workstation block is there because it is used where it stands once set down. The size is a placeholder for a thing too big for a pack. Rendered at --size 512.

name: Aluminium stepladder
description: A light aluminium stepladder with five treads and plastic feet.
notes: Shares the wooden stepladder's model in bare aluminium with a grey plastic top; real aluminium rails are thinner channel, which the shared model does not show.

name: Charcoal stick
description: A stick of charcoal sharpened to a point and wrapped in rag at the back. It writes on wood, paper and walls, and blackens the hands.
notes: One stick 10 cm long and 12 mm across, the point at +x. A single stick this size weighs about 8 g, so the mass follows the stick, and the charges become wear. writing is the quality the jumbo marker also brings. A pencil variant is a different object (a wooden pencil) that cannot share a charcoal stick's model; it needs its own row and is left out here.

name: Homemade telescope
description: Three plastic tubes bound with tape that slide out into a telescope. It shows distant ground clearly but is too crude to aim through.
notes: Drawn pulled out to 38 cm: three nested tubes up to 42 mm across, tape at each joint, an eyepiece at -x and the objective at +x. Collapsed it would be about 18 cm. spotting is a new quality name for seeing further; widening the mapped area while carried needs a field the content pass adds. The lenses are glass-clear, drawn opaque in the tile.

name: Tear gas spray
description: A pocket canister of pressurised tear gas with a flip-top trigger and a key ring. Sprayed in a face, it blinds and chokes for a while.
notes: 9 cm tall and 34 mm across with the nozzle facing +z and the key ring at the back. Spraying a cone of gas needs an effect field the content pass adds; about twenty seconds of spray as charges.

name: Angular whistle
description: A small whistle of dark, faintly blue metal, all sharp and uneven angles. Its note is too high to hear, yet something always seems to answer.
notes: 6 cm long: a skewed mouthpiece at -x, a twisted wedge body with a crooked fin, a black window and a loop at +x, in steel-blued with void-black. The name here describes the thing. Calling a hostile creature when blown is for the content pass.
